method: Synthetic adversarial clips generated locally with ffmpeg (clearly labeled synthetic, generated at test time into a temp dir — no committed corpus clips modified; committed bundle clips were only READ for the before/after coverage check). One degraded dimension per clip: 8fps, 426x240, near-black exposure (eq brightness=-0.45), heavy gaussian blur (gblur sigma=12), 0.5s duration, 90/180-degree rotation metadata (stream copy, byte-identical video), VFR timestamps (alternating 58.3ms/8.3ms intervals, avg ~29.9fps).

breaks.finding: VFR clip with alternating 58.3ms/8.3ms frame intervals (interval CV ~0.75) was verdicted SUPPORTED overall: only ffprobe avg_frame_rate (~29.9fps, inside supported band) was checked; timestamp irregularity was invisible.
breaks.fix: New timing_stability dimension: coefficient of variation of inter-frame presentation intervals from packet pts (sorted). Thresholds provisional: supported max 0.15, degraded max 0.35. Thresholds set re-versioned to capture-envelope-thresholds-v0.2-provisional (dimension set changed); verdicts remain provisional:true.
breaks.regression_test: packages/capture-envelope/test/redteamEnvelope.test.ts: 'VFR timestamps are detected on timing_stability even when avg fps passes'

breaks.finding: 90-degree rotation metadata (byte-identical video stream, -c copy) silently violated the normalization contract: ffmpeg auto-rotates on decode but sampling used stored (pre-rotation) dims, so frames were scaled to the wrong aspect — measured Laplacian variance changed 387.6 -> 577.9 (+49%) on identical pixels. Overall verdict stayed SUPPORTED here, but blur/camera-motion measurements were corrupted for every rotated phone capture (the common mobile case).
breaks.fix: probeClipStream now reads rotation from stream side_data (Display Matrix) / rotate tag and exposes display dims (swapped for 90/270); measureClip samples and reports display dims. 180-degree rotation now provably measurement-identical to unrotated.

open.finding: Encoder/mux timebase quantization can collapse VFR jitter into duplicate pts (delta=0); probeFrameIntervalCv drops non-positive deltas, so a clip whose jitter rounds to duplicated timestamps measures CV 0 and passes timing_stability. Duplicate-pts frames are themselves a timing anomaly; a duplicate-fraction signal would be a follow-up dimension. Not fixed here to keep the v0.2 change minimal and honestly reported.

coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.after: DEGRADED / DEGRADED / DEGRADED — every pre-existing per-dimension status identical; new timing_stability measures SUPPORTED (interval CV 0.0000) on all 3
coverage_on_committed_positive_gold.delta: 0 regressions, 0 new abstentions; fixes are not blanket abstention

contracts: usable-result-v1 / silent-failure-v1 untouched; envelope thresholds re-versioned v0.1 -> v0.2 (provisional) because the dimension set changed; verdicts still carry provisional:true.
held_out: wm-dink-01 / afn-vic-rally1 not modified (wm-dink-01 read-only measured, exactly as the existing C12 eval already does).
tests: pnpm --filter @pickle/capture-envelope test: 23/23 green (13 unit + 10 red-team synthetic); typecheck green.
